items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the interviewer mentions Rosetta Thorpe without the interviewee confirming any personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: Who was the agent for black religious music, gospel and spiritual and stuff like that?

I know who you're talking about. The last time I saw him was down to the Central Plaza. I tell you one you might - maybe you won't like him but I really did - I don't know if you know Rosetta Thorpe. I don't care what Ethel Waters sings, I love it.
Oh, you mean Ethel Waters had something against Rosetta Thorpe?
